title: Left coordinate route equals canonical Kunneth map after composition
statement: theorem coordinateKunneth_leftRoute_comp_kunneth [Finite A] {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsProper f] (L : DerivedCategoryModule A Y) (M : DerivedCategoryModule A X) : ((orderedProjectionIso A f ((push A f).obj M) ((pull A f).obj L)).hom ≫ (push A f).map (comparison A f L M).inv ≫ (directComparison A f).hom.app _) ≫ (rightDerivedLowerStarCompIsoOfComp (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) (pullback.fst f f) f (pullback.fst f f ≫ f) rfl).hom.app _ = kunnethMap (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) (pullback.fst f f) (pullback.snd f f) f f (pullback.fst f f ≫ f) rfl (pullback.condition (f := f) (g := f)).symm M ((pull A f).obj L)

proof.text: Rewrite the canonical Kunneth map by `kunnethMap_eq`, exposing its projection/base-change factorization and the same direct-image compositor.
Cancel the monomorphism given by the canonical right-derived composition isomorphism. Apply the pre-composition mate calculation for the left coordinate route.
